# Delete File

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Deletes the provided file.

## Syntax

~~~~text
deleteFile(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>, confirm: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
deleteFile(input: selectedFile, confirm: false)
~~~~
